title: MAC Learning & Flooding
description: Understand how switches learn MAC addresses and handle unknown unicast and broadcast flooding.
scenario: Understand how switches learn MAC addresses and handle unknown unicast and broadcast flooding.

concepts.title: How Switches Learn
concepts.body: A switch learns MAC addresses by reading the source MAC of every frame. It builds a MAC table mapping MAC → port.
concepts.code:
Frame arrives on Fa0/1 with src MAC 00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E
Switch learns: 00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E → Fa0/1

concepts.title: Unknown Unicast
concepts.body: If the switch does not know the destination MAC, it floods the frame out all ports in the VLAN (except the source).
concepts.code: Unknown unicast → flood to all ports in VLAN

concepts.title: Broadcast Flooding
concepts.body: Broadcast frames (FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF) are flooded to all ports in the VLAN. This is how ARP works.
concepts.code:
Broadcast → flood to all ports in VLAN
ARP request → broadcast → all ports
